notes: Slabs (src/Slabs.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals and no transfer fee. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 SLABS to msg.sender once. It has no external mint, burn, administrative or upgrade functions. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool uses the requested paired token with a 0.3% fee and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with SLABS as currency0 and the paired token as currency1. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the supplied economics and totalSupply, accounting for currency ordering.
